The most ABBA song titles identified from the track in one minute is 21, and was achieved by Akarsh Chalasani (UK) in London, UK, on 30 May 2024.
Akarsh first came across ABBA when he watched Mamma Mia in 2020. Since then he has listened to all of their albums, and watched the Mamma Mia movies, West End play and the Voyage concert multiple times.

### Business career (2000–2015)
Following an internship in 2000, Sunak worked as an analyst for investment bank [Goldman Sachs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goldman_Sachs "Goldman Sachs") between 2001 and 2004.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak#cite_note-whoswho-23)[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak#cite_note-Business-25) He then worked for [hedge fund](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hedge_fund "Hedge fund") management firm [The Children's Investment Fund Management](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Children's_Investment_Fund_Management "The Children's Investment Fund Management") (TCI) from September 2006 to November 2009.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak#cite_note-26)[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak#cite_note-27) He left the fund to join former colleagues in California at a new hedge fund firm, Theleme Partners, which launched in October 2010 with $700 million under management.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak#cite_note-28)[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak#cite_note-29)[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak#cite_note-30) At both hedge funds, he directly reported to [Patrick Degorce](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patrick_Degorce "Patrick Degorce").[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak#cite_note-The_Guardian_Feb_2020-31) Sunak was a director of the investment firm Catamaran Ventures, owned by his father-in-law, the Indian businessman [N. R. Narayana Murthy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/N._R._Narayana_Murthy "N. R.
